profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at General Motors
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with 5 years at General Motors, specializing in Warehousing, Supply Chain, and Logistics. 
Throughout my career, I have successfully deployed and maintained warehousing operation systems across North America while supporting 15 international warehouses, ensuring seamless operations and optimized workflows.

I am proficient in Kubernetes, Java, Python, and SQL scripting, with a strong focus on building scalable, efficient solutions. My role demands the ability to quickly learn and adapt to evolving technologies, which has enabled me to stay ahead in fast-changing environments. I thrive in problem-solving scenarios, continuously improving processes through automation and innovative software development.

Currently, I am seeking software development opportunities to enhance my technical abilities and contribute to dynamic, growth-oriented teams. I am passionate about applying my expertise to create impactful software solutions while expanding my skills in modern tools and frameworks.
